corpus: NTU Speech Corpus for L2 Mandarin
purpose: Conservative candidate list for human T5 annotation. These entries must not be counted as T5 benchmark support until an annotator verifies the audio token and its prosodic realization.

policy.minimum_review: one trained annotator plus adjudication for disputed tokens
